summary: Clearway Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that on October 1, 2026, its subsidiary Honeycomb 2 Purchaser LLC entered a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement with Honeycomb 2 CE Seller LLC, a Clearway Energy Group affiliate, to acquire membership interests in Honeycomb 2 TargetCo LLC, which will indirectly own Escalante BESS II, Escalante BESS III and Granite Mountain BESS West LLC. Base purchase price is approximately $119 million cash, subject to financial-model adjustments; the three Utah battery storage projects total roughly 210 MW. Closing expected in Q4 2027, subject to customary conditions and third-party actions; no board recommendation or advisor named. Post-closing, Purchaser holds 100% Class A units while CEG affiliate Clearway Renew LLC retains 100% Class C units, a structural overhang; watch regulatory and third-party approvals given the long-dated close.
